image_location_description: Left side: large light/dark gray rectangular block with studded top surface.

steps.title: Lower brick layer (half)
steps.description: Add 4x LBG 1x2 bricks (3004) on base, start a 4x4 ring.

steps.title: Lower brick layer (finish)
steps.description: Add 4x more LBG 1x2 bricks (3004) to complete 4x4 layer.

steps.title: Dark center band
steps.description: Place 2x DBG 2x4 bricks (3001) side-by-side on top.

steps.title: Top plates (front)
steps.description: Add 2x LBG 1x4 plates (3710) to cover front half.

steps.title: Top plates (rear)
steps.description: Add 2x LBG 1x4 plates (3710) to finish 4x4 studded top.

steps.title: Side smooth accents
steps.description: Add 2x LBG 1x2 tiles (3069b) on opposite side faces.
